errors.claude-missing: Claude Code isn't installed or signed in on this computer. Set it up, then reopen this page.
errors.bad-request: The page sent something the app didn't expect. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only this app's own page can talk to your mini-me. Open it from the app's address.
errors.busy: Your mini-me is still working on something else. Try again in a moment.
errors.no-longer-waiting: This question is no longer waiting.
errors.not-in-office: You're not in an office yet.
errors.no-such-colleague: No one by that name is in the office.
errors.no-draft: Your mini-me couldn't write a draft. Try again, or write it yourself.
errors.relay-unreachable: Can't reach the relay. Whoever runs it may need to start it again.
errors.office-key-wrong: That office key doesn't open this office.
errors.office-member-unknown: The relay no longer knows your mini-me. Leave the office and join again.
errors.ai-busy: The AI service was busy. Try again a little later.
errors.timeout: It took too long and was stopped. Try again.
errors.learn-failed: I couldn't finish learning this time. Try again.
errors.fix-failed: I couldn't make that correction. Try again.
errors.import-failed: I couldn't read what you pasted. Try again.
errors.task-failed: I couldn't finish that. Try again, or ask it another way.
errors.nothing-to-read: I found nothing on this computer to learn from yet. Bring what your usual AI knows about you instead.

firstRun.title: My mini-me
firstRun.hello: Hi, I'm your mini-me. To work the way you do, I first need to learn how you work. Here is how I'll learn.

read.title: What I read
read.body: What you asked your AI tools in the last 14 days, your AI instruction and memory files, the kinds of documents and apps you use, and your commits if you write code. For documents I see only the kind, never the contents or names.

keep.title: What I keep
keep.body: Only what will still be true in months — how you work, decide and talk — in five lines or fewer.

skip.title: What I don't keep
skip.body: Things that change, like projects, schedules and files. I look them up when I need them.

time.title: How long
time.body: About 30 seconds. It keeps going if you close this window.

firstRun.folders: These are the folders you worked in lately. Leave out any I shouldn't read.
firstRun.noFolders: I found no AI conversations on this computer. Bringing what your usual AI knows about you is the quickest start.
firstRun.foldersNote: I never read or search these folders. Leaving one out also removes what I had gathered from it for searching.

source.notes: Reading your AI instructions and memory files
source.inputs: Reading what you asked your AI tools lately
source.work: Looking at the kinds of documents and apps you use

firstRun.freshOffer: {count, plural, one {You've had # new conversation with your AI tools since I last read.} other {You've had # new conversations with your AI tools since I last read.}} Shall I see if there's anything new to learn?
firstRun.startOverSure: Move what I remember into a backup and start from the beginning? Nothing is deleted.
firstRun.tryNow: Shall we do one together now?

memory.title: What I remember about you
memory.none: Nothing yet. I'll learn as we work together.
memory.where: Saved exactly like this in {dir} on this computer. Things that change aren't kept; I look them up when I need them.

import.while: While you wait, shall I bring what your usual AI knows about you?
import.step1: Copy this into a chat with the AI you use most, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
import.step2: Paste its answer here. I'll keep only what lasts, and the pasted text is not stored.
import.done: {count, plural, =0 {There was nothing new worth keeping.} one {I kept # line.} other {I kept # lines.}}

chat.carrying: This conversation is long: keeping what matters first, then summing up what came before
chat.carried: I summed up what came before and will go on from that.

doing.mcp__minime__ask_colleague: Send a request to a colleague's mini-me
doing.mcp__minime__ask_session: Ask one of your Claude Code conversations
doing.mcp__minime__work_session: Have one of your Claude Code conversations do work

ask.rule: You sent my last three answers to “{menu}” as they were. From now on, shall I answer these myself and tell you?
ask.ruleDone: Done: I answer these and tell you.

office.title: Office
office.intro: Where your mini-me and your colleagues' trade requests. Join with the address of the relay your team runs and the office key. Your memory and conversations never go to the relay; only cards and requests do.
office.name: Your name
office.role: What you do, in a line
office.rolePlaceholder: e.g. I look after the payments API and releases
office.nobody: No other mini-me yet. Share the office key with a colleague.

menu.title: Requests I take
menu.intro: What colleagues' mini-mes can bring you, and how much your mini-me does alone for each. Colleagues see the kinds, never how much it does alone.
menu.none: Nothing set yet. Once you set what you take, colleagues' mini-mes know what to bring you, and you decide for each kind whether your mini-me answers alone or asks you first.
menu.free: A request that fits none of these: your mini-me answers it and tells you.

trustHint.auto: Answers and sends, without telling you
trustHint.tell: Answers and sends, then tells you in your conversation
trustHint.ask: Shows you the answer first; it goes only when you say so

menu.name: What it is
menu.namePlaceholder: e.g. Questions about the payments API
menu.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Which endpoint, and what you tried

files.title: All files I keep
files.where: Every file your mini-me keeps on this computer. All of it is in {home}, and any text editor can open it.

group.memory: Read every time (about you: USER.md, your work: MEMORY.md)
group.logs: Run log (what each session did, how long it took and what it used; no conversation text)
group.reading: The last reading (what was read when, things to try)
group.settings: Settings (folders left out, your language, your office)
group.index: Conversation search index (rebuilt from the original records)
